rationale: Reviewed `maven-build-lifecycle/SKILL.md` for the reported issues and confirmed it no longer hardcodes repository-specific paths (e.g., `google/auto`) and instead consistently uses the task-prompt placeholder `/home/travis/build/failed/<repo>/<id>` for `cd` and `patch_{i}.diff` locations.

Confirmed the JDK guidance is conditional on CI configuration (the JDK 7 switch is clearly labeled as an example only when CI requires it) and the Maven command guidance instructs running the exact CI command rather than assuming a specific `-f build-pom.xml` or fixed goal set.

Verified the file now contains a dedicated section on nested test projects (Maven Invoker / integration-test fixtures) including common dependency/parent resolution failure modes, a focused diagnostic checklist, and explicit modification-scope rules that prefer fixing the main reactor/build configuration over editing fixtures.
residual_risks: Even with conditional wording, readers may still over-apply the provided example commands (e.g., `mvn -B -U verify --fail-at-end`) instead of precisely mirroring CI; this is mitigated but not eliminated by the surrounding guidance.

Nested fixture behaviors vary by plugin configuration (custom local repo, invoker settings, pre-install expectations); the guidance is general and may need repo-specific interpretation to choose between reactor fixes vs fixture POM edits.
